summary.text: 1940年，格伦·西博格（Glenn Seaborg）和他的团队在伯克利加州大学，利用回旋加速器用氘核轰击铀，制造出了94号元素——钚（Plutonium）。这是继镎之后的第二个超铀元素。西博格后来发现钚-239是可以裂变的，这意味着它可以用于制造原子弹。这一发现被立即列为二战期间的最高机密。西博格后来又参与发现了另外9种超铀元素，重塑了周期表的结构，提出了“锕系”概念。
summary.text_en: In 1940, Glenn Seaborg and his team at UC Berkeley used a cyclotron to bombard uranium with deuterons, creating element 94—Plutonium. It was the second transuranium element after Neptunium. Seaborg later discovered that Plutonium-239 is fissile, meaning it could be used for atomic bombs. This discovery was immediately classified Top Secret during WWII. Seaborg went on to co-discover 9 more transuranium elements and reshaped the periodic table by proposing the 'Actinide' series.
key_points: 合成了关键的核燃料/核武原料：钚 (Pu)
提出了“锕系理论”，重新排列了周期表底部
一生共参与发现了10种新元素
唯一一个在世时就用自己名字命名元素（Seaborgium, Sg）的人
key_points_en: Synthesized the key nuclear fuel/weapon material: Plutonium (Pu)
Proposed the 'Actinide Theory', rearranging the bottom of the periodic table
Co-discovered 10 new elements in his lifetime
The only person to have an element named after them while still alive (Seaborgium, Sg)

fun_facts.text: 西博格选择“Pu”作为钚的符号（而不是Pl），就像小孩子闻到臭味时发出的声音“Pee-Yew”，这是一个化学圈的幽默。
fun_facts.text_en: Seaborg chose the symbol 'Pu' for Plutonium (instead of Pl) as a joke, referencing the sound a child makes when smelling something bad ('Pee-Yew').

story.text: 西博格改变了我们对周期表的看法。之前的教科书认为铀之后的元素应该像过渡金属一样排列。西博格大胆提出，它们应该形成一个新的系列（锕系），放在镧系下面。老一辈化学家告诉他：“如果你发表这个，你的科学生涯就毁了。”但他发表了，而且他是对的。
story.text_en: Seaborg changed how we look at the Periodic Table. Textbooks thought elements after Uranium should line up like transition metals. Seaborg boldly proposed they form a new series (Actinides) below Lanthanides. Older chemists told him, 'If you publish this, your career is ruined.' He published it, and he was right.

impact.text: 钚的发现彻底改变了世界格局，它不仅是核武器的关键原料，也重塑了科学界对元素周期表的理解。西博格提出的“锕系”理论是自门捷列夫以来对周期表结构最大的修改。
impact.text_en: The discovery of plutonium changed the world order; it was not only a key material for nuclear weapons but also reshaped the scientific understanding of the periodic table. Seaborg's 'Actinide' theory was the most significant modification to the table structure since Mendeleev.

influenced_by.contribution: 基于门捷列夫的周期律，但对其进行了大胆修正
influenced_by.contribution_en: Based on Mendeleev's periodic law but made a bold correction to it

influenced.contribution: 为人造超重元素的合成奠定了理论和实验基础
influenced.contribution_en: Laid the theoretical and experimental foundation for synthesizing artificial superheavy elements

influence_chain.legacy_text: 西博格不仅制造了毁灭性的元素，也重写了化学教科书。
influence_chain.legacy_text_en: Seaborg not only created a destructive element but also rewrote chemistry textbooks.

quiz.question: 西博格提出的“锕系理论”对元素周期表做了什么改变？
quiz.question_en: What change did Seaborg's 'Actinide Theory' make to the periodic table?
options: 将重元素排成两行放在底部
options_en: Added a column of noble gases
Placed heavy elements in two rows at the bottom
quiz.explanation: 他提出锕系元素应该像镧系元素一样，作为内过渡元素排在周期表下方，而不是夹在过渡金属中。
quiz.explanation_en: He proposed that Actinides should be placed below the main body of the table as inner transition elements, similar to Lanthanides, rather than among the transition metals.
